description: Source code for the JetPlayer class in Android's media framework, managing audio playback, threading, and event handling for the JetPlayer component.

classes.name: JetPlayer
classes.description: Manages audio playback, threading, and event callbacks for the JetPlayer component in Android.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the JetPlayer, including EAS library, audio track, and render thread.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources, stops playback, and shuts down the EAS library.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Render thread function that processes audio data and manages playback.

methods.name: fireEventsFromJetQueue
methods.description: Dispatches queued JET events to callback.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads a JET file from a filesystem path.

methods.name: loadFromFD
methods.description: Loads a JET file from a file descriptor.

methods.name: closeFile
methods.description: Closes the currently opened JET file.

methods.name: setMuteFlags
methods.description: Sets mute flags for multiple tracks.

methods.name: setMuteFlag
methods.description: Sets mute flag for a specific track.
